Headphones Not Pairing? 1. Hold power button 5+ seconds for pairing mode. 2. Toggle Bluetooth off/on on your device. 3. Remove old pairing and try fresh. 4. Ensure headphones are charged above 10%. 5. Move closer to device, away from WiFi routers. 6. Try resetting headphones (check manual for model-specific instructions).

Power Bank Not Charging Device? 1. Try a different USB-C cable. 2. Press power button to activate output. 3. Check device wattage compatibility. 4. Try a different port if display shows error. 5. Fully discharge then recharge the power bank. 6. Some devices require specific protocols (PD, QC) - verify compatibility.

Mouse Not Working? 1. Check battery level or charge the mouse. 2. Try different USB port for receiver. 3. Re-pair Bluetooth connection. 4. Update mouse drivers/firmware. 5. Test on different surface (some sensors struggle on glass). 6. Check for interference from other wireless devices.

Monitor No Signal? 1. Check cable connections at both ends. 2. Try a different cable (HDMI, DisplayPort, USB-C). 3. Press input/source button to select correct input. 4. Try different port on your computer. 5. Test monitor with another device. 6. Update graphics drivers.

Keyboard Keys Not Responding? 1. Check battery or charge keyboard. 2. Toggle Bluetooth off/on. 3. Remove and re-pair the keyboard. 4. Check for debris under keys. 5. Try different USB port (if wired). 6. Reset keyboard to factory settings.

Slow SSD Performance? 1. Check if drive is nearly full (keep 10-20% free). 2. Update SSD firmware. 3. Enable TRIM (usually automatic on modern OS). 4. Check thermal throttling - ensure proper airflow. 5. Verify PCIe slot is running at correct speed in BIOS.

TV Picture Quality Issues? 1. Check input resolution matches content. 2. Disable motion smoothing for movies. 3. Enable Game Mode for gaming (reduces input lag). 4. Adjust HDR settings if picture looks washed out. 5. Calibrate using built-in calibration or professional tools. 6. Update TV firmware.
